record.title: Senegal COVID land-border closure
record.exceptions: Goods transport excepted on Mauritania frontier; security personnel, foodstuffs and medical services/equipment excepted in Gambia bilateral order. October 19 Senegal High Commissioner described special clearance and a negative COVID test for intending travellers.
record.enforcement: Policy evidence; crossing-level implementation not independently established

record.context: Mauritania boundary order effective 21 March and Gambia joint closure announced 23 March. National land/sea closure retained in 29 June presidential speech; Senegal side of Gambia boundary still described as closed on 19 October.
record.uncertainty: No verified single national effective day; prior 20 March date may conflate modes or announcement phases. Last-confirmed date applies specifically to Gambia frontier, not proof every land crossing remained closed. Endpoint unresolved.
